contactText: Write to us with technical questions, feedback or translation suggestions.
offlineAnswer: Lernfino stores vocabulary, story progress and practice results on your device. Download the available lesson media while connected to use it offline. The available content depends on your plan. AI evaluation needs internet access.
backupQuestion: How do I move my progress to a new device?
backupAnswer: On the old device, open Settings, choose Backup Learning Data and transfer the resulting JSON file to your new device. In Settings on the new device, choose the backup file to restore your progress.
examAnswer: The eight full mock exams are independent study material in Goethe and ÖSD formats. Take a complete timed exam or practice Lesen, Hören, Schreiben and Sprechen separately. The optional AI evaluations for Schreiben and Sprechen require explicit consent from an adult aged 18 or over.
audioQuestion: How do I use the story and dictionary audio?
audioAnswer: Play a story to follow along with its highlighted text. You can adjust the playback speed or tap a word for its contextual dictionary entry and available audio.
deletionQuestion: How do I delete my account or learning data?
localTitle: Delete learning data on this device
localText: If you use Lernfino without an account, open Settings and choose Reset Learning Data. You can also uninstall the app to remove its local data from the device.
accountText: In the app, open Settings, choose My account, then Delete account and confirm. This removes the account and synced data, including authentication details, learning progress, saved vocabulary, scores, transcripts and AI feedback. In-app deletion also clears account progress and queued drafts on that phone. Anonymous cost metrics and a random deletion receipt are retained.
emailText: If you cannot open the app, prepare a deletion request and send it from the email address associated with your Lernfino account. Requests are processed and verified within seven business days. Deleted data cannot be recovered.
emailSubject: Lernfino Account and Data Deletion Request
emailBody: Please permanently delete my Lernfino account and associated data. Please confirm once the deletion is complete.
